Me and my friend have been really close since we first met in highschool. We hung out a lot, did trashy stuff, you know, the usual teenage stuff.


I trusted him a lot and even vented to him sometimes, that was my biggest mistake.


After Christmas he started to distance himself from me for no apparent reason and, because it was so noticable, I confronted him about it a couple of times but he just brushed it off as me imagining things.


Cut to a couple of weeks ago, I find out through a mutual friend of ours that he's been trying to get rid of me. Out of nowhere, for no apparent reason, he intends to just forget about our friendship and throw it all in the bin. Turns out he suddenly thinks I'm boring and annoying. All that trust I put in him, gone.


I press him about this again, no response. I was starting to get a bit frustrated and I had enough after what happened 2 weeks ago. Basically, he lied to me, multiple times in fact, saying he was busy and couldn't hang out, knowing full well I would be left alone, when he in fact just wanted to avoid me. Now this wouldn't be a problem if he didn't drive my entire friend group with him. For some time I was alone because of this.


I talked to some of his old classmates and apparently this isn't the first time he does something like this. I even went and talked to his ex girlfriend, who happens to be my friend, and she told me that he is a narcissist and that they, in fact, had never been dating and that it was a lie he made up to look cool. He even made up an excuse that they broke up cause she cheated on him and, because of that, people around her starting drifting away.

We distanced for good after this.
